sloka: मुहूर्तम् अथ विश्रान्तौ राज पुत्रौ अरिन्दमौ ।प्रांजली मुनि शार्दूलम् ऊचतू रघुनंदनौ ॥१-२९-२८॥
transliteration: muhūrtam atha viśrāntau rāja putrau arindamau ।prāṁjalī muni śārdūlam ūcatū raghunaṁdanau ॥1-29-28॥

translations.english: The two princes of the lineage of Raghu, destroyers of foes rested a while and then said to Viswamitra, a tiger amon sages:
